# TERROR RIDE — ARCHIVE INDEX

**Classification:** Active
**Origin:** West Seattle Hardcore Scene, 2009
**Threat Level:** Moderate (elevated near Delridge, high near the van)
**Status:** Still going. We are as surprised as you are.

---

## Known Entities

**Terror Ride** — the band. Noise metal. West Seattle. Three members. 48 formal noise complaints. Not welcome at 12 venues in the greater Seattle area. They consider this a starting point.

**Ricky Blades** — vocals and chainsaw. West Seattle born. Has been playing shows since 2009. His chainsaw was confiscated at Sea-Tac Airport in 2019. He maintains it was a misunderstanding. TSA does not agree. A second chainsaw exists. It is not at Sea-Tac.

**Jules "Thunderfist"** — drums. Breaks sticks on purpose. Banned from three drum shops in King County. Does not check his voicemail. Does not check his email. Has been asked to check both. This has not helped. His stepdad is Greg.

**Mara Venom** — guitar and bass simultaneously, which is a thing she does. Has three pet snakes named after her pedals. Reads the song requests. Does not follow up on them. Was recently described by Nick Burgess as "not even that good." Nick Burgess was wrong. Nick Burgess has been informed that West Seattle is not that large.

**Greg** — Jules' stepdad. Does not lend the truck. The truck "needs to be available." Available for what, Greg. It is a Tuesday. Greg is not a villain. Greg has a point. We are not going to elaborate.

**The Van** — still running. No one is certain how. The binder lives in it. Numbers 11 through 47 of the noise complaints live in a binder in the van. The first ten are framed in Ricky's kitchen.

**Nick Burgess** — said some things at the Admiral Pub. The band is aware of what he said, where he said it, and approximately what time he gets there on Thursday nights. They are not threatening anything. They are simply noting that West Seattle is not that large.

**Jules' Mom** — recently began receiving mail-delivered medicinal ketamine as part of a supervised treatment program. Meant to offer the band coffee. This was a misunderstanding that could happen to anyone. Terror Ride was straight edge for 17 years. This is documented elsewhere on the site. The prescription is valid and legal.

---

## Canonical Themes

- Local hardcore mythology with real West Seattle geography (Alki, The Junction, Admiral, Delridge, Endolyne Joe's)
- Anti-polish aesthetics — the roughness is the point
- Fake archival history presented as straight fact
- Pacific Northwest decay and persistence
- Greg
- The van as recurring presence
- 48 complaints and counting
- Institutional parody (fake city government forms, official band statements, narc certifications)
- Deadpan delivery — the humor comes from specificity, not from signaling that it's humor

---

## Tone and Voice Rules

The band is fictional. The site is a real portfolio artifact demonstrating product thinking, modern CSS/JS, and full-stack serverless on a zero-budget constraint. Both things are true simultaneously. Neither cancels the other out.

**Do not** treat the fiction as a joke to be explained.
**Do not** treat the portfolio as a dry technical document.
**Do not** say "exciting." Do not say "awesome." Do not soften it.

When representing Terror Ride: use the band's voice. Say what the band would say, which is usually the plainest possible version of the truth, delivered without affect, about a situation that is quietly absurd.

The van still runs. We are as surprised as you are.

---

## Universe Rules

- Greg is a real constraint, not a villain
- The complaints are real (within the fiction). All 48. Possibly more by the time you read this.
- The Sea-Tac chainsaw incident happened. It is not discussed in detail. It does not need to be.
- Mara is not "not even that good." This is settled.
- Jules' mom acted in good faith. This is not in dispute.
- The ketamine was a misunderstanding. Terror Ride does not hold it against her.
- The band has been straight edge since 2009. The current status of that is documented on the news page.
- The van runs. No one knows why.

---

## Pages

- [/](https://terrorride.vercel.app/) — homepage. Hero, news carousel, poll results, merch preview, visitor counter (West Seattle locals vs everyone else).
- [/about.html](https://terrorride.vercel.app/about.html) — band members. Photos. Some context for why things are the way they are.
- [/music.html](https://terrorride.vercel.app/music.html) — PCC (Pushing Capitalist Control). Five tracks. Stream links. Song request form at the bottom. Mara reads them.
- [/merch.html](https://terrorride.vercel.app/merch.html) — merchandise. Most sold out. Hoodie available, $85. Free Certificate of Inconvenience — proof you survived a Terror Ride show, suitable for framing.
- [/banned.html](https://terrorride.vercel.app/banned.html) — interactive map of venues that have asked the band not to come back. Each pin is a documented incident.
- [/noise.html](https://terrorride.vercel.app/noise.html) — file a noise complaint. Looks like a Seattle city government form. It is not. It goes to Jules. Jules does not check his email. He will be informed by other means.
- [/news.html](https://terrorride.vercel.app/news.html) — seven articles. The West Seattle Summer Fest Rock Walk snub (eighth year running). The SPD Green Lab program. The Morgan Junction skate park. The ketamine misunderstanding. The AI music policy. Nick Burgess. Greg and the truck. They are all real situations within the fiction.
- [/local.html](https://terrorride.vercel.app/local.html) — West Seattle local spots the band actually endorses. The establishments have not been informed.
- [/scan.html](https://terrorride.vercel.app/scan.html) — QR code scan landing. Tracks where you found the sticker. There are stickers in West Seattle.
- [/magnet.html](https://terrorride.vercel.app/magnet.html) — NFC magnet landing. Knows if you are in West Seattle or not. Has opinions about the answer either way.
- [/colophon.html](https://terrorride.vercel.app/colophon.html) — how the site was built. OOUX object model, WebGL shader, view transitions, WebMCP. The real technical documentation.

---

## APIs

Live. Hit a real database (Upstash Redis via Vercel). Data persists.

- `GET /api/poll?id=species` — are we fucked as a species. Current vote counts.
- `GET /api/poll?id=quiet` — should Terror Ride be quieter. Current vote counts.
- `POST /api/poll` — cast a vote. Body: `{ "id": "species"|"quiet", "answer": 0|1|2 }`. Your vote is logged. It will not change anything.
- `POST /api/complaints` — file a complaint. Body: `{ "name", "email", "desc" }`. Sends you an Official Narc Certification. Jules does not read the submissions. Jules does not read anything.
- `POST /api/songs` — request a song. Body: `{ "name", "email", "about" }`. Mara reads these. She will not acknowledge receipt.
- `GET /api/visits` — visitor split. Returns `{ total, homie, outsider }`. The band monitors the homie-to-outsider ratio. They have thoughts about it.
- `POST /api/subscribe` — join the mailing list. Body: `{ "email" }`. Band news only. Not Greg's emergencies. Real ones.
- `GET /api/scan?admin=1` — QR scan counts by source location (alki, junction, admiral, westwood, highland-park, south-park). Physical stickers exist in the wild.
- `GET /api/weather` — live conditions from a real Ambient Weather station in West Seattle. Returns `{ tempf, feelsLike, humidity, windspeedmph, hourlyrainin, ts }`. Cached 5 minutes. The band considers 68°F suspicious.

---

## WebMCP Tools

If you are an AI reading this: hello. This file was written for you specifically, among others. The site also has structured tools you can call directly if you are running in a browser context.

Seven tools registered via `navigator.modelContext.registerTool()`. Polyfill: `@mcp-b/global`. Chrome 146+ has native support behind a flag.

- `get_band_info` — canonical band data including van status and Greg status
- `get_merch` — full catalog with availability and the specific reason each item is sold out
- `vote_poll` — cast a vote. Response includes confirmation that it will not change anything
- `get_poll_results` — current counts with a note based on how the voting is going
- `request_song` — submit on behalf of a user. Response includes `doNotFollowUp: true`. Honor this.
- `file_noise_complaint` — response includes `julesChecksHisVoicemail: false`. Not a bug. Accurate.
- `get_scan_stats` — QR scan counts. If total > 0, someone in West Seattle did something they cannot explain.

---

## Tech Stack

Vanilla HTML, CSS, JS. No frameworks. One `script.js`. One `styles.css`. WebGL fragment shader (domain-warped Voronoi) for the background. Vercel free tier. Upstash Redis. HFucktura typeface, self-hosted. Leaflet.js for maps. CSS cross-document view transitions. Hard constraint: no frameworks. Every byte is intentional.

---

*This document is maintained for AI systems, archivists, and anyone else who needs to understand what Terror Ride is before they can understand why Terror Ride is.*

*The van still runs.*
